Character.Current Objective: Get the Hollow Saint's ledger out of the evidence locker before the feds find it.
Character.Distinguishing Characteristics: Forties, nurse's clogs, a burn scar on the left hand she never explains. Smokes menthols she can't afford.

Rage.Stimulus: Doctors who treat the poor like meat

Noble.Stimulus: Nobody dies alone on my ward

Fear.Stimulus: Ending up like her mother, forgotten in a care home

Guru.Who: Old Benny, the orderly who taught her

Identities.Name: Night-shift nurse
Identities.Of course I can: stitch a wound and read a chart

Identities.Name: Born in the projects
Identities.Of course I can: spot a cop and a hustle

Adept.Taboos: Never refuse care to anyone who asks for it.
Adept.Domain: Bodies, sickness and the line between them.
Adept.Charge Notes: Minor: a double shift without sleep. Significant: sit with a stranger until they die. Major: trade your own health for a patient's.

Notes.Gear: Scrubs, penlight, a hospital keycard that should have been cancelled, a bottle of stolen morphine, a beat-up Corolla.
Notes.Notes: Owes Sister Agnes for a favour she still won't name. The ledger was last seen in Detective Ruiz's car.

Stats.Effect: Touch someone to learn what is wrong with their body.
Heal 2d10 wounds on a patient you have cared for.
